description: This file is a shell script intended for testing git repository structure and related functionalities. It contains multiple test cases using a testing framework, verifying the output of a command that inspects repository structure, and makes use of git commands and test utility functions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to execute after tests.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a single commit for testing.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file.

methods.name: test_file_not_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a file is not empty.
